question_text: Describe the full-day activity timeline at DemoBooth_NVIDIA on 2025-12-08 (UTC). Identify the busiest time windows, any lulls, and quantify the peak crowd sizes versus the baseline. Write 3-5 sentences.

rubric: Peak head_count values are substantially higher than baseline of ~3
Overnight / early-morning hours show baseline/quiet activity

answer_text: On December 8, 2025, the DemoBooth_NVIDIA experienced distinct peaks in activity. The busiest time windows occurred from 10:00 to 11:00 UTC and again from 15:00 to 16:00 UTC, with average head counts reaching 60 and 70, respectively, and peak head counts peaking at 75 and 86. In contrast, the early and late hours of the day were quieter, with average head counts hovering around 3.5, punctuated only occasionally by peaks of 18 to 21. The baseline activity reflects the ongoing ebb and flow characteristic of managing an exhibit space, illustrating dynamic, time-sensitive visitor engagement patterns typical at major expo events.
